main_text.l: Isti autem sunt filij prouinciæ, qui ascenderunt de captiuitate transmigrationis, quos transmigrare fecerat Nebuchadnefar Rex Babel in Babel: & reuerfi sunt in Ierusalaim, & in Iehudah, singuli in ciuitatem suam.
2 Qui venerunt cum Zerubbabel, Iefua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordochai, Bilsan, Misspar, Bignai, Rehu, Baanah. Numerus autem virorum populi Israelis:
3 Filij Paros, duo millia centum septuaginta duo.
6 Filij Pahat, Moab, filiorum Iefua, Ioab, duo millia octingenti, & duodecim.
7 Filij Elä, mille ducenti, quinquaginta quatuor.
12 Filij Azgad, mille ducenti & viginti duo.
14 Filij Bignai, duo millia quinquaginta sex.
16 Filij Ater ipsi Hizcijah, nonaginta octo.
25 Filij Ciriathiarim, Cephirah, & Beroth, septingenti quadraginta tres,
26 Filij Haramah et Gaba, sexcenti viginti vno.
28 Filij Bethel & Ai, ducenti viginti tres.

page.notes: Printed lines in italic; the marginal numbers 2–28 are verse numbers set in the text column. Some letters, such as those in Hebrew-derived names, are doubtful. The number "Numerus" and some names may show ink damage.
